items.definition:
a step leading up to the outer door of a house
The package was left on the doorstep.

a man or boy (informal)
He's a good fella, always willing to help.

a person or company that grows produce
The local fruit grower sells fresh apples.

unpleasant physical effects following excessive drinking of alcohol
He woke up with a terrible hangover after the party.

a person or thing that hits
He's known as a powerful hitter in baseball.

a structure where bees live
The bees returned to their hive at dusk.

an optical instrument for viewing small objects
We used a microscope to examine the cells.

outing
We had a lovely family outing to the park.

paycheck
She received her first paycheck today.

router
My internet router needs to be reset.

a strong pull
She felt a gentle tug on her sleeve.

a quick closing and opening of one eye
He gave her a quick wink to show he was joking.

a signature, especially of a celebrity
She waited for an hour to get his autograph.

a type of grain
Barley is often used in brewing and animal feed.

large deer
We saw an elk in the forest.

extreme tiredness
He felt complete exhaustion after the marathon.

unique mark from a finger
The police found fingerprints at the scene.

a flat, hanging part
The envelope had a sticky flap.

Stolen money or goods.
The thieves escaped with their loot.

Software designed to disrupt, damage, or gain unauthorized access to a computer system.
Always use antivirus software to protect against malware.

A painting or other art form executed directly on a wall.
The artist painted a beautiful mural on the side of the building.

A distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one.
There was a strange odor coming from the kitchen.

a short oar
We used a paddle to move the canoe.

a small pin or knob
Hang your coat on the peg by the door.

the outline of buildings against the sky
The city skyline was beautiful at sunset.

a person who receives and pays out money in a bank
The bank teller helped me deposit my check.

a video camera connected to a computer
I use my webcam for video calls.

a large primate without a tail
Chimpanzees are a type of ape.

a nocturnal mammal
A badger dug a sett in the field.

a person who bowls; a type of hat
The bowler aimed carefully at the pins.

a community of nuns; the building in which they live
She decided to join a convent after finishing her studies.

a baby's bed with high sides; a small house or apartment; a cheat sheet
The baby slept soundly in her crib.

an intersection of two or more roads; a crucial point in a situation
We found ourselves at a crossroads, unsure which path to take.

a person who is eating a meal; a small, informal restaurant
We stopped at a classic American diner for breakfast.

an evergreen coniferous tree
We decorated a fir tree for Christmas.

a former monetary unit of France, Belgium, Luxembourg, and other countries
Before the euro, the franc was the currency of France.

goalkeeper
The goalie made an incredible save.

a type of fish
Smoked herring is a popular dish in Scandinavia.

a person who plays the piano
She dreams of becoming a professional pianist.

a small cucumber preserved in vinegar
I like to eat a pickle with my sandwich.

the action of repeating something that has already been said or written
Repetition helps in memorizing new vocabulary.

an act of washing something lightly
Give the vegetables a good rinse before cooking.

a movable cover for a window or door; the part of a camera that opens and closes to expose the film or sensor
She closed the shutters to block out the light.

a secondary title of a book, film, or other work; captions displayed at the bottom of a movie screen
I always watch foreign films with subtitles.

the quality or state of being sweet
The sweetness of the fruit was delightful.

the combined action of a group, especially when effective and efficient
Teamwork is essential for the success of the project.

an alcoholic spirit made from the blue agave plant
They ordered margaritas made with tequila.

a sharp point on a plant
Be careful, that rose has a sharp thorn.

unidentified flying object
Many people claim to have seen a UFO in the night sky.

a small printed piece of paper that entitles the holder to a discount or to exchange it for goods or services
I used a discount voucher to buy the book.

a person or thing that breaks or destroys something; an informal term of address
Hey, buster, get off my lawn!

a blackish residue from burning; a type of fish
The fire left a layer of char on the wood.

a device for connecting things electrically or mechanically
I need a new USB connector for my phone.

a large wooden box
They packed the fragile items in a wooden crate.

buttocks (American English)
He fell and landed on his fanny.

a man to whom one is engaged to be married
She introduced her fiancé to her parents.

a cone-shaped utensil with a tube at the apex, used for pouring liquid or powder into a small opening
She used a funnel to pour the oil into the bottle.

a thing intended to simulate or copy something else
The cheap handbag was a poor imitation of the designer original.

a strap or cord for leading an animal
He put the dog on a leash before going for a walk.

a mythical creature with the head and torso of a woman and the tail of a fish
Children often dream of seeing a real mermaid.

a fine powdery substance, typically yellow, consisting of microscopic grains discharged from the male part of a flower
My allergies act up when there's a lot of pollen in the air.

a style of music that originated in Jamaica in the late 1960s
Bob Marley is a famous reggae musician.

a person who examines or assesses something, especially a critic of books, films, or plays
The movie reviewer gave the film a positive rating.

a public exhibition of cowboy skills, such as bronco riding and calf roping
We went to a rodeo last summer and saw bull riding.
